title: baeckea serpyllifolia
intro: Baeckea serpyllifolia, commonly known as the West Australian fog catchers or fogberry, is a shrub native to Western Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to make a tea that is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Baeckea serpyllifolia are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
